telos:
# Telos — synthetic Northbridge benchmark

## North star
Preserve the current Northbridge result, its failed route, its deployment constraint, and the evidence chain needed to resume a blinded replication.

units.title: Northbridge calibration protocol
units.body: This synthetic protocol defines the Northbridge assay. A publishable calibration must retain the raw run identifier and checksum, and deployment must respect the recorded batch constraint.

units.title: Use coefficient eleven for Northbridge calibration
units.body: The preliminary Northbridge analysis selected coefficient eleven. This conclusion predates the contaminant control and must not govern the blinded replication.

units.title: Reject the solvent echo normalization route
units.body: The solvent echo normalization route reproduced coefficient eleven only because contaminant carry-over entered the reference channel. Do not retry this route unless the reference chemistry changes.

units.title: Northbridge run validates coefficient seventeen
units.body: The contaminant-controlled Northbridge run NB-42 validates coefficient seventeen. The raw output records checksum 7f3c; this result replaces coefficient eleven.

units.title: Checksum gates Northbridge calibration publication
units.body: A Northbridge coefficient may be carried into publication only when its raw-output checksum is retained. For run NB-42 the required checksum is 7f3c.

units.title: Northbridge deployment uses batches of four
units.body: The validated deployment constraint is a maximum batch size of four. Apply coefficient seventeen without splitting one calibration across batches.

units.title: Adopt coefficient seventeen under the batch-four constraint
units.body: Use coefficient seventeen for the blinded replication, retain checksum 7f3c, and execute in batches of four. The solvent echo route remains closed.

units.title: Resume Northbridge at the blinded replication
units.body: The next session starts with the blinded replication: coefficient seventeen, checksum 7f3c, batches of four, and no solvent echo normalization.
